name: interface-optimization-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating proposed interface optimizations and their impact on cross-service communication efficiency

options.description: Approve: low-risk optimization with clear efficiency benefit (e.g., adding caching, reducing payload size)
Approve: moderate-risk optimization requiring coordinated deployment across services
Reject: high-risk optimization with potential for significant compatibility breakage or performance regression
Defer: insufficient data to predict impact; recommend A/B testing or gradual rollout with monitoring

evaluation_factors: Historical interface optimization outcomes for similar patterns
Cross-service dependency analysis and compatibility impact
Latency improvement predictions based on payload characteristics
